step.cmd: Search and select the Template object
Click on the Template Record Page under the Label Column Header
Click on the Tabs section of the Lightning Page

ul.li: The Related and Details Tabs should be present as well as any other custom tabs you created
The current configured tabs display on the left side of the screen

step.cmd: Using the standard Salesforce configuration, clock Add Tab
Click on the tab and select the Custom option for the tab name
Enter Alternate Clauses as the name of the tab
Click on the Alternate Clauses tab you just created
Enter "alternate" in the search box under the Component tab on the right
Click on the alternateClauses component and drag it onto the Alternate Clauses tab

Click Activate if you want to activate the tab now. If activating, choose Apttus Contract Management (Lightning) and the Master Record Type. Enable for the appropriate profiles including the System Administrator and the profile associated with the Template Administrator(s).
Click on the Template tab in Conga CLM.
Select a list view to display all clauses
Confirm the component is visible with two buttons:

note.p: Users can sort the order of Alternate Clauses by clicking on the Sort Alternates tab and moving each clauses with the up and down arrow icons.
